_readme: Maps internal market identifiers to the column the board renders.
column must be one of: result | total | corners | cards | other
'types'  -> the FIRST number inside the odds id bracket, e.g. the '264' of
'groups' -> the oddsGroup id, e.g. the '54211' of {"id":"54211", ...}
groups wins over types. Anything not listed falls back to heuristics in
server/push-decode.mjs (1x2 when outcomes contain x, under/over with a line
>= 6.5 is shown as corners, otherwise total).
To find the ids for CORNERS and CARDS: open a football match on the site,
locate the corners / cards price in the UI, note the group id (or the number
in the odds id) from the frames relayed to your backend, then add it here.
Expanded market types for football:
1      = 1X2 result
264    = Over/Under goals (Total Goals)
301    = Asian Handicap (Fora)
302    = Double Chance (Shans i Dyfishte)
303    = Both Teams to Score (GG/NG)
307    = Corners (finds by name heuristic as fallback)
308    = Cards (finds by name heuristic as fallback)
311    = Yellow Cards
312    = Red Cards
320    = Total Corners (Over/Under Corners)
321    = Corners Handicap (Asian Corners)
323    = Total Cards (Over/Under Cards)
Since market type IDs vary by provider, the heuristics in push-decode.mjs
also classify by outcome names: if outcomes contain '1','x','2' -> result,
if a line >= 6.5 -> corners (throw-in counts), else total. The explicit
types below ensure correct classification when the heuristic disagrees.
